entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: That Shadow must be Shinya's mother.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Shadow spotted! Is she that gamer[n]Shinya's mom?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: She looks like she would bite us if we[n]even tried to speak to her.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I heard she's the definition of a helicopter[n]parent. She's really selfish too.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: We gotta do somethin' about this! Kids[n]really look up to their parents, you know?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Let's go, guys!

entries.speaker: Shadow Oda
entries.en: You can't survive in this cold, harsh[n]world if you're too soft!

entries.speaker: Shadow Oda
entries.en: No one will help a single mother![n]Everyone just looks at me coldly!

entries.speaker: Shadow Oda
entries.en: Everyone is my enemy! I have to fight[n]them! I have to smash them before they[n]can smash me!
Stop playing the victim.
You're making your son suffer.

entries.speaker: Shadow Oda
entries.en: What do you know!? You don't know me!

entries.speaker: Shadow Oda
entries.en: We have to be strong! We don't have[n]a safety net to catch us if we fall!

entries.speaker: Shadow Oda
entries.en: I'm just fighting for my own happiness![n]I don't want others to mock us anymore!

entries.speaker: Shadow Oda
entries.en: I lost. I'm going to get everything taken[n]from me again...

entries.speaker: Shadow Oda
entries.en: Society sees me as a loser. I've got no[n]money. I have no reason to be proud of[n]myself...

entries.speaker: Shadow Oda
entries.en: What the hell am I supposed to do...?
Change your thinking.
You have your son.

entries.speaker: Shadow Oda
entries.en: Shinya...

entries.speaker: Shadow Oda
entries.en: I have Shinya...

entries.speaker: Shadow Oda
entries.en: Yes... I realize that now. The greatest[n]happiness... was with me this whole time.

entries.speaker: Shadow Oda
entries.en: I have to be a good mother for his sake.
This mother will have[n]a change of heart now...
I should head to Shinya...
